name: Last Shop Before Boss
source:
You are playing the classic role-playing game "Last Quest - The Legendary Hero". But just as you stock up in the last shop before the final boss, a grave accusation threatens your adventure. Can you defend yourself? Or will your path change from here on? 

[From [url=https://halfstar.itch.io/last-shop-before-boss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在玩经典角色扮演游戏《最后的任务-传奇英雄》。但正当你在最终老板面前的最后一家商店里进货时，一项严重的指控威胁着你的冒险。你能保护自己吗？或者从现在开始你的道路会改变吗？

[来自[url=https://halfstar.itch.io/last-shop-before-boss]itch.io[/url]]
